categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the research, design, production, and sales of protective accessories for mobile smart terminals, including phone cases, tablet cases, wearable device cases, and straps. Its business is divided into two main segments: ODM/OEM services for global well-known mobile terminal manufacturers and accessory brands, and proprietary brand business under the brand 'Juesse' targeting mid-to-high-end markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-precision mold development, automated injection molding production, composite molding materials and structures, smart dimming film materials, and flexible perovskite power generation technology. It emphasizes R&D in new materials, innovative decoration processes (IMD), ultra-light and ultra-thin protective technologies, and integrated composite materials to enhance product quality and functionality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global mobile terminal manufacturers such as Huawei, Samsung, Honor, Wentai Technology, and Vivo, as well as large chain supermarkets and international accessory brands. The company serves the consumer electronics industry, focusing on mobile smart terminals and related protective accessories, with a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for nearly 79% of revenue, and exports to regions including North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Hong Kong, the United States, and Jiangxi province, supporting a global multi-level regional layout.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing ODM/OEM manufacturing services and proprietary brand products. It integrates R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales, offering a full-process closed-loop service in the mobile smart terminal protective accessories industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core business, breakthrough growth, and organizational evolution with a focus on ESG governance. R&D focuses on new materials, high-quality innovative technologies, low-cost fiber decoration processes, and product design to reduce costs and improve quality. The company also emphasizes digital manufacturing, supply chain integration, and customer-centric innovation to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of ODM/OEM products to large customers and distributors, and through sales of proprietary brand products via a dealer network. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from financial assets, but product sales remain the main revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the niche market of mobile smart terminal protective accessories with early industry entry and strong ODM/OEM capabilities. It competes with other accessory manufacturers globally, leveraging its comprehensive R&D, manufacturing automation, and established relationships with top-tier mobile terminal manufacturers and brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 761.6 million, representing a 12.59% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.07 million. The company has a total asset base of over RMB 2.1 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, showing a positive growth trajectory after previous losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through high-quality, fashionable, and technologically advanced protective accessories tailored for mid-to-high-end markets. Its value proposition includes rapid market response, comprehensive closed-loop industry chain services, innovative material technologies, and strong customer service, enabling it to meet diverse customer needs and maintain competitive advantages globally.
